question: Approve the redone design (amendment 1) and enter implementation on the #651 branch? Approving accepts D1 (a red run reaches you only by GitHub's failed-run notice to the pushing account, no FO words) and D2 (a push the runner cannot read is a red 'cannot judge' run), each as recommended, and is the grant for the implementation worker to push to the #651 branch.

artifacts.summary: Redo under Captain amendment 1: each push is judged on its own before..after commits; anchors and the stays-red guarantee are dropped, so adoption starts green and a violation is reported once. Kept from #651: the check-running and fail-closed core, L2 reading a record at its adding commit, the laws file, the workflow skeleton, 18 of 30 tests. Replaced: the enumeration, the CLI and the shallow guard, by one diff-tree -M walk over the push range. Replay over 198 real pushes (2026-10-13 to 15): 24 would have been red, 2 of the 69 after 2026-10-14T09:00Z. Risk under D1: the next push is green, so a missed notice is a missed violation; AC-8 (whether the notice reaches you) still needs your answer. ADR 0017 reserved. design_surfaces.py check exit 0.
